# Etsy MCP

Work on Etsy API or shop tasks by following [`.github/agents/etsy.agent.md`](../agents/etsy.agent.md).

## Typical requests
- Find listing endpoints and required scopes
- Set up OAuth (PKCE) for an Etsy seller app
- Inspect `ShopReceipt` or `ShopListing` schemas
- Bulk-edit prices or inventory, with a preview first
- List unshipped orders and add tracking
